findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: The nozzles on the soda machine were observed soiled. Discussed with PIC. PIC removed the nozzles and instructed a staff member to clean and sanitize them. Inspected reexamined the nozzles and they appeared cleaned and sanitized. Ensure that food contact surfaces such as the soda nozzles are monitored, cleaned, and sanitized at a regular frequency.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: The sanitizer bucket was recorded at 0ppm at the start of the inspection. The sanitizer bucket was made during the inspection and tested at 200ppm QUAT from the dispenser at the triple sink. Ensure sanitizer buckets are readily available and regularly tested to ensure the efficacy of the sanitizer remains intact. 
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (A) chlorine shall have minimum temperature (55F), concentration (100ppm), and pH (10). (B) Iodine shall have 68F, pH of 5 or less and concentration of 12.5ppm and 25ppm. (C) Quaternary ammonium shall have 75F, concentration based on label, and water with 500ppm hardness or less. (D) - (E) Meets EPA-label use and regulatory authority approval. (P) (F) Other chemical sanitizers in-use shall have EPA-registered label, display device registration number on device and is operated and maintained in accordance with manufacturers instructions (Pf)

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The following areas were observed with an accumulation of dust/soil:
-The gaskets of the pizza prep cooler have an accumulation of food soils.
-The wire shelf above the prep table has an accumulation of dust/soils.
Ensure these surfaces are cleaned and sanitized to remove the current accumulation and then cleaned and sanitized at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean. 
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: The lights in the kitchen and the air vents are observed with an accumulation of dust. Ensure the lights and air vents are cleaned to remove the current accumulation and then cleaned at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean. 
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.
